stories.title: ‘One big family’: Flintshire foster carers on the scheme no other Welsh council offers
stories.summary: Flintshire remains the only council in Wales running the Mockingbird fostering scheme, six years after introducing it, Foster Wales Flintshire said. Foster Wales Flintshire, Flintshire County Council’s fostering service, introduced the scheme in 2020 and said it was the first local authority in Wales to do so. stories.title: Mynydd Isa Scout leader to lead school repair team in Malawi over Christmas
stories.summary: A Scout leader from Mynydd Isa will spend Christmas and New Year in Malawi leading a team repairing a primary school damaged by a tropical cyclone. Lily, a leader with Mynydd Isa Scouts, has been selected to join a group of 10 Scouts from across the UK and is the only one travelling from Wales.

stories.title: Former Deeside College trainee completes degree while managing 300 staff at Kingspan
stories.summary: A Connah’s Quay engineer who manages more than 300 staff at the Kingspan plant in Greenfield has completed a business degree at Coleg Cambria at the age of 50. stories.title: Parents must be treated as “vital to the care team” in Welsh neonatal units, minister tells Senedd
stories.summary: Parents must be treated as “vital to the care team” and not as visitors when their child receives neonatal care, Wales’ Women’s Minister has said.
